messages:
olivia (audits): FYI — kicking off a cross-domain admin elimination next Tue 10am PT. Scope: org-level admin roles + cross-account KMS grants. Goal: reduce admin entitlements by ~30% and close mismatched KMS bindings. Will run canary then phased rollout.

jess (engsec): thanks. what's the rollback plan if CI jobs or infra automation break due to missing perms?

olivia (audits): rollback plan = re-add the minimal role via emergency svc-account with 1h TTL + runbook steps. Canaries first in staging. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/admin-elim (draft).

raj (infra): can you paste the query you're using to enumerate cross-account KMS bindings? I'll run it against staging audit replica.

olivia (audits): sure — quick query I ran against auditdb:

```
SELECT principal, resource, binding_id, granted_by, created_at
FROM kms_bindings
WHERE account != resource_account AND role ILIKE '%admin%'
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
```

Run with auditdb-readonly. Filters: exclude service-accounts with tag:auto-allowed.

mike: add me to canary watchers. I can monitor cloudlogs and trace spikes.

anna: are external vendor principals included? last sweep missed a vendor binding and it took manual follow-up.

olivia (audits): yes vendors are in scope. Last run flagged 12 vendor principals — we'll attach vendor-proof tickets and require owner attestation before removal.

jess (engsec): vuln triage note: two high severity findings link to privileged role escalation when admin bindings are changed. Patch APR-22 mitigates the escalation vector. Recommend gating mass pruning on APR-22 deployment. @olivia can we gate on that?

olivia (audits): good catch. Gate condition: "APR-22 deployed to all prod regions". Adding to checklist.

anna: proposed checklist (short):
- create staging canary group
- run KMS-binding query + export CSV
- notify owners via owners-bot + open attestation tickets
- apply least-priv role template to flagged bindings
- watch telemetry for 2h; rollback if error-rate > 1% or failed CI jobs
- collect audit evidence bundle (logs + attestation)

raj (infra): owners-bot note — verify owner emails mapped to infra oncall; some services use owner:platform-team alias. Make sure we don't auto-remove when owner is a group alias.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: cross-admin-prune-canary at 2026-03-30T17:00Z by olivia — status: scheduled :calendar:

mike: I'll run a 15m incident-response drill during the canary (simulated permission regression) to verify our rollback path and runbook clarity.

olivia (audits): perfect. I'll open the PR with the target list, attach the runbook, and post the owners CSV in #eng-security. Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
